findings.scenario: The amended check counts 29,819 red pixels on the impl capture, and 26,578 of them are the waived Submit button.
findings.issue: The blob assertion proves nothing on the impl layout, because the Submit button alone clears the threshold.
findings.fix: Count blob pixels only inside each red edge run's y-span.

findings.scenario: Any revealed fill that wraps across lines loses its per-fragment padding.
findings.issue: The renderer drops the padding that box-decoration-break:clone gives in the reference.
findings.fix: Extend the box by the pad width in drawFillStroke.
